Then T020-T024 shifts to explaining parent's view. Now the seeker accepts that view partially. Asking a question continues the conversation which might be expected in a chatbot interaction unless signaling closure. However, asking "Have you talked..." might imply advice/giving next steps when the seeker hasn't explicitly asked for advice on talking to parents recently (they did earlier in H001, but this is current session).
